note: Named characters for the pronoun and name system. gender is m, f or x, or "opposite:<id>". A variable <id>.gender or <id>.name set by the story overrides these. names picks a name by gender. aliases and surnames are per book id ("default" applies to any book not listed). Love interests are added with the books they appear in; their gender is set by the player with $ <id>.gender = "f".

prisca.name: Prisca
prisca.title: Head of the Merchant coven
prisca.bio: A woman who might be forty or four hundred, with an abacus and a great deal of patience. She lends to every power in Rome, and she has taken you in.

domitia.name: Domitia
domitia.title: Mother of your spouse
domitia.bio: Your spouse's mother, a widow who keeps a hard face and a soft kitchen. She came to stay when the house went quiet.

sextus.name: Sextus
sextus.title: Shepherd of Collesanto
sextus.bio: An old shepherd with a bad knee and a good ear. He is the only man in the village who takes his sheep near the villa wall.

quintus.name: Quintus
quintus.title: A boy of Collesanto
quintus.bio: A boy of twelve with long arms and a stubborn mouth. The village does not listen to him, and he has noticed.

fuscus.name: Fuscus
fuscus.title: The collector's man
fuscus.bio: A thickset man in a good cloak who collects what Rome says it is owed, and a little more besides.

tiro.name: Tiro
tiro.title: A younger member of the Merchant coven
tiro.bio: A bookkeeper's son turned at nineteen, who was never good at sums and is very good at people. He talks when he is afraid, and he is afraid quite often.

galerius.name: Galerius
galerius.title: Lictor of the Senate of Blood
galerius.bio: An officer of the Senate's enforcers, polite, patient and very old. He has been told to watch you.

hanno.name: Hanno
hanno.title: Keeper of the Merchant house ledgers
hanno.bio: A Carthaginian who has kept accounts for three hundred years and has said perhaps nine hundred words in that time.

naevia.name: Naevia
naevia.title: Keeper of a wine shop in the Subura
naevia.bio: A freedwoman of fifty with a baker's arms and a face that has never been fooled twice. She is the first customer you did not frighten.

lucrio.name: Lucrio
lucrio.title: A grain factor of the Merchant house
lucrio.bio: A handsome heavy man with a good ring who has been taking a tenth of a cart a day. He knows a great many debts.

vibia.name: Vibia
vibia.title: A woman of the Subura
vibia.bio: A thin tired woman with a mended dress and a husband who is not coming home. She came to ask a stranger for help.

et_love.title: Test beloved
et_love.bio: A developer person who shows how the People screen lists someone you have met.

rufus.name: Rufus
rufus.title: A vigil of the Aventine station
rufus.bio: A plain square watchman with a leather bucket and ash to the elbows, who has seen a great many fires and is the first man in Rome to say that someone is lighting them.

flavus.name: Flavus
flavus.title: A lamp seller of the Velabrum
flavus.bio: A lame freedman with kind eyes and a clean shop, devoted to Vesta, who has never had to lie about anything.

theron.name: Theron
theron.title: Head of a General line coven
theron.bio: A Greek ancient turned in Macedon who marched with Alexander's armies. Battle scarred, half an ear, a great many war stories, some of which may be true.

meritamun.name: Meritamun
meritamun.title: Head of a Scribe line coven
meritamun.bio: An Egyptian coven head who treats Romans as clever children playing with a civilization older than their city. Learned, proud, and dangerous in debate.

tarrax.name: Tarrax
tarrax.title: Commander of the Lictors
tarrax.bio: Firstborn of the General line and the Senate's iron fist. Tall, grey and perfectly kept. He is said to fear one thing, and it is not a living thing.

general.name: The General
general.title: First of the General line
general.bio: A very big, very old man who was put under the hill before there was a city on it. He is courteous, dry, and in no hurry, and everyone around him is afraid of what he will want.

valeria.name: Valeria
valeria.title: Mistress of the hill, in the year 410
valeria.bio: A woman of the Valerii, in the eleventh generation since Aelia, with a cross on her stole and a lamp in her hand. She was told one sentence to say, and never expected to say it.

wisand.name: Wisand
wisand.title: A captain of Alaric's host
wisand.bio: A tired Gothic officer with a thick yellow beard and one rule for the night: that the churches are to be left alone.

rufinus.name: Rufinus
rufinus.title: A notary of the Aventine
rufinus.bio: A dry, careful notary of a burial society, who keeps a very old book that nobody has asked to see.

eudoxia.name: Eudoxia
eudoxia.title: Chamberlain of the Senate of Blood at Constantinople
eudoxia.bio: A Greek vampire of great age and great manners, who runs the court from a chair in a cistern and has never raised her voice.

ioannes.name: Ioannes
ioannes.title: A mason at the Great Church
ioannes.bio: A mason of Constantinople with plaster in his beard, who has been laying gold on the dome for five years and does not intend to stop.

ginevra.name: Ginevra
ginevra.title: Matriarch of the Valerio family
ginevra.bio: A very old, very small woman in a white cap who has the chin of every Valerio there has ever been, and runs the hill as a general would, with the difference that she is obeyed.

tommaso.name: Tommaso
tommaso.title: Factor of Collesanto
tommaso.bio: Ginevra's son, a heavy dark mason of forty who keeps the walls, the books and the keys. He is honest in a way that makes liars uncomfortable.

fiammetta.name: Fiammetta
fiammetta.title: A young woman of the Valerio family
fiammetta.bio: Tommaso's daughter, seventeen, quick, curious, and too clever for the hill. She has been told that she will one day keep it.

benedetto.name: Benedetto
benedetto.title: A clerk of Prisca's bank
benedetto.bio: Benedetto Orlandini, a thin young correspondent with ink on his cuffs and an iron nerve. He has been waiting all his life to be asked to do something extraordinary.

ambrogio.name: Fra Ambrogio
ambrogio.title: A Dominican of Santa Maria Novella
ambrogio.bio: A lean, courteous friar with a good Latin hand and a reputation for finding out what is true. The Archbishop sends him when a miracle needs looking at.

gualtiero.name: Gualtiero
gualtiero.title: Prince of Florence
gualtiero.bio: A small gray man of the Priestess line with a scholar's face and pale eyes, who sits on a plain chair because a plain chair is more alarming than a throne. He knows the debts of every vampire in the city and is patient about using them.

ottaviano.name: Messer Ottaviano
ottaviano.title: Seneschal of the Prince
ottaviano.bio: A tall, correct vampire in black with a silver ring and a pouch of blue leather. He is cleverer than his master and a good deal more frightened.

vieri.name: Vieri Salimbeni
vieri.title: A young vampire of the court
vieri.bio: Twenty three for some years now, with a good coat, a gold chain and a handsome sneer. He tests strangers in alleys, and he tells the story afterward.
